requirements.title: Continue the existing product
requirements.requirement: Start from the latest myorivia-release-plan and current deployment record. Inventory existing modules, migrations and tests before editing. Preserve working features; do not restart the app or create a second product.
requirements.acceptance: Record exact starting SHA, pilot/production versions, database bindings by identifier and pending branches.

requirements.title: Use the current integrated baseline
requirements.requirement: At preparation time GitHub head is a846926, recording the integrated Chat refresh. Cleo has already integrated the six design fixes and paused staff progress totals. Verify the current head rather than replaying old commits.
requirements.acceptance: No duplicate design merge, stale embedded bundle, or re-enabled progress total slips into the candidate.

requirements.title: One integrator and independent reviewer
requirements.requirement: Cleo integrates and deploys only to the isolated pilot during this work. Ina reviews source and the deployed candidate. Founder gets one final acceptance presentation before any production promotion.
requirements.acceptance: Candidate records separate Cleo test result, Ina review result and founder production decision.

requirements.title: No routine founder questions
requirements.requirement: Choose conservative reversible defaults described here. Continue independent tasks when an integration is blocked. Ask only for genuinely unavailable credentials, a new payment or a consequential decision that cannot be inferred.
requirements.acceptance: No repeated requests for founder to check an unfinished screen or choose ordinary spacing and copy.

requirements.title: Do not claim universal completion
requirements.requirement: This is a bounded comprehensive v1 specification and extensible architecture, not a promise that every future human need can be predicted. Each requirement has a status and evidence. External dependencies remain explicitly blocked.
requirements.acceptance: No placeholder, mock metric, simulated university record or unsubmitted store package is counted as complete.

requirements.title: Protect existing data
requirements.requirement: Migrations are additive and versioned with backups/restore instructions. Preserve chats, manual titles, saved guides, calendar events, files, memberships and preferences across upgrades.
requirements.acceptance: Run migration, failed-write, interrupted-upgrade and rollback checks using synthetic copies.

requirements.title: Enforce the deadline honestly
requirements.requirement: Founder target is 22 October 2026 at 22:30 Asia/Dubai. Work toward a coherent tested pilot candidate; never trade privacy, data integrity or truthful status for a deadline.
requirements.acceptance: At cut-off supply completed scope, evidence and a concise external/blocker list; do not pretend the store fee is necessarily the only item left.

requirements.title: Hold production
requirements.requirement: No production deploy, budget increase, new provider, mass email, university contact, purchase, public share or store submission is authorised by this specification alone.
requirements.acceptance: Pilot changes and release report are reviewable before the founder approves promotion.

requirements.title: Use status vocabulary consistently
requirements.requirement: Use existing, in progress, implemented unverified, locally verified, pilot verified, blocked external, deferred by scope and released. Complete means the specified acceptance passes, not that a button is drawn.
requirements.acceptance: Every requirement carries owner, status, tested SHA, environment, evidence and any remaining dependency.

requirements.title: Release evidence is operational data
requirements.requirement: Do not upload personal interview text, secrets, real student documents or private chat content into public GitHub evidence. Use synthetic accounts, fictional Northbay and sanitized results.
requirements.acceptance: A repository scan and review find no uploaded founder contacts, credentials or participant-identifying research notes.

requirements.title: One product shell
requirements.requirement: Use shared navigation, typography, spacing, account controls and institution context across personal app, student space, staff platform and founder management. Every destination is reachable through UI, without typing a URL.
requirements.acceptance: Guest, student, editor, admin and owner reach only their permitted spaces through menus and Back.

requirements.title: Professional visual hierarchy
requirements.requirement: Aim for the polish of a serious institutional platform: generous margins, clear tables, useful summaries, restrained navy surfaces, amber accents and precise empty states. Do not imitate a university crest or imply a partnership.
requirements.acceptance: Desktop overview and detail pages, 390px phone, 768px tablet and wide desktop use coherent hierarchy without overflow.

requirements.title: Semantic colour system
requirements.requirement: Use Orivia amber for primary accents and selected navigation. On light surfaces use a darker accessible amber for link text; on dark surfaces use lighter amber. Keep error/delete red and success green. Do not simply make every link bright yellow.
requirements.acceptance: Check contrast, hover, focus, disabled and selected states in light/dark. Link identity is also conveyed by underline, icon or context.

requirements.title: Replace unrelated blue links
requirements.requirement: Internal account, space, join/manage, help and settings links use brand-semantic tokens rather than browser default blue. Content-source classifications remain distinct.
requirements.acceptance: Audit all personal/student/staff/owner screens and auth notices; no accidental browser-blue navigation remains.

requirements.title: Typography and density
requirements.requirement: Use clean body text, consistent type scale and restrained serif display headings where approved. Staff tables support comfortable and compact density with readable minimum sizes.
requirements.acceptance: Long university names, Arabic, 200 percent zoom and large text do not clip key actions.

requirements.title: Navigation by purpose
requirements.requirement: Personal tabs are Home, Chat, Library, My Life and Calendar. Guidance lives inside Library and contextual Home/Chat offers. Staff and owner get their own serious navigation inside the same shell.
requirements.acceptance: Switching space preserves active identity and makes personal versus organisation context visible.

requirements.title: States are designed features
requirements.requirement: Every page supports loading, empty, success, permission refused, partial data, stale data, offline, error and retry states. Loading indicators describe real work.
requirements.acceptance: A failed fetch does not leave a blank card, frozen spinner or plausible-looking fake number.

requirements.title: Destructive actions
requirements.requirement: Delete and destructive confirmations are red, specific and scoped. Preserve existing confirmation/Undo semantics. Do not let a global delete mean different things on different pages.
requirements.acceptance: Deleting a Library file, chat, reminder, membership and account each explains its own consequences.

requirements.title: Consistent interaction polish
requirements.requirement: Use controlled motion, visible pressed/focus states, predictable menus, generous touch targets and reduced-motion support. Close buttons are easy to see and named.
requirements.acceptance: Keyboard-only use, pointer use and touch simulation can complete each core flow.

requirements.title: Performance is visual too
requirements.requirement: Reserve space for images/cards, avoid layout shifts, and render the shell promptly. Do not block a whole screen behind one optional widget.
requirements.acceptance: Slow images, missing voices or failed analytics do not prevent chat, navigation or safe fallback.

requirements.title: Useful personal Home
requirements.requirement: Show greeting, destination-country image, ask box, nearest upcoming dates, active plans, recent chats and institution spaces. Prefer relevance to a wall of tiles.
requirements.acceptance: Home question starts a new conversation and sends once; existing chat and unsent drafts remain intact.

requirements.title: Country imagery is honest
requirements.requirement: Decorative photo caption names the country, not an assumed city. Image is bundled or privacy-safe; no geolocation is inferred from its presence.
requirements.acceptance: Sharjah profile is not captioned Dubai; no destination has a readable non-image fallback.

requirements.title: Personal profile fields
requirements.requirement: Preferred name, origin country/city, current place, destination country/emirate or UK nation/town, move reason, institution free text and language remain editable and clearable.
requirements.acceptance: Origin never silently becomes nationality, immigration status or current residence.

requirements.title: Institution recognition
requirements.requirement: An entered institution is unverified until a matched official identity/campus is confirmed. Show alternatives and source; do not silently attach a similarly named school.
requirements.acceptance: Ambiguous names require selection and a mismatch can be corrected without changing personal origin.

requirements.title: Profile sharing control
requirements.requirement: Explain which saved profile details reach each AI route and honour the actual consent. Device-only fields must not leak through planning, search, voice, documents or retries.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic hidden city/name tests confirm provider payload boundaries.

requirements.title: Organisation onboarding
requirements.requirement: Join links open the correct branded welcome before authentication. Destination/reason may be prefilled and locked as institutional context; personal corrections remain separate.
requirements.acceptance: Expired invitation, pending membership and normal personal-use escape route work.

requirements.title: No double welcome
requirements.requirement: One account/guest entry and versioned consent flow. Refresh, installation, account restore and institution arrival do not repeat obsolete trial screens.
requirements.acceptance: Restarting the browser retains valid agreement and refreshes only expired human verification.

requirements.title: Personal control centre
requirements.requirement: My Life shows profile, preferences, saved places, memberships, data/export/deletion and permission guidance through an uncluttered hierarchy.
requirements.acceptance: No account setting is only accessible through a hidden URL.

requirements.title: Age aware content
requirements.requirement: Avoid unnecessary birth dates. Explain limits for minors and family use without collecting children’s identifiers for ordinary help. Use age-appropriate plain language when relevant.
requirements.acceptance: A school-registration request asks for year group only when useful, not names, ID numbers or exact birth dates.

requirements.title: Preferences persist safely
requirements.requirement: Theme, text size, language and voice options use account-scoped storage where applicable and guest storage separately.
requirements.acceptance: Switching accounts does not transfer the previous person’s personal defaults.

requirements.title: Maintain conversation intent
requirements.requirement: Understand informal wording, typos, corrections and short follow-ups. Resolve them against the latest relevant user goal rather than an old special route.
requirements.acceptance: Year 6, all of them, contact them, the landlord and a corrected institution work through multi-turn scenarios.

requirements.title: Research without permission loops
requirements.requirement: When asked to find information, do the permitted research. Ask a concise clarification only when it materially prevents a useful answer.
requirements.acceptance: Yes please does not trigger another permission question or repeat an unchanged directory result.

requirements.title: Preserve conversation branches
requirements.requirement: Represent edited prompts and regenerated answers as versions/branches with stable IDs. Keep previous versions accessible and send only the selected path to the model.
requirements.acceptance: Switching versions restores matching sources, cards and document context; superseded turns do not contaminate a new answer.

requirements.title: Copy response
requirements.requirement: Copy the intended reply with sensible formatting, excluding controls and private hidden metadata. Show success/failure and keep keyboard access.
requirements.acceptance: Clipboard result contains the complete selected version, not animated partial text.

requirements.title: Edit user message
requirements.requirement: Allow editing the user’s own message with Cancel and Save and resend. Preserve the original branch. Explain that subsequent answers belong to the old branch.
requirements.acceptance: An edited destination does not reuse stale route evidence or silently edit a saved reminder.

requirements.title: Regenerate response
requirements.requirement: An explicit regenerate makes a new capped provider request, preserves the previous answer, and shows version navigation. Do not duplicate saved actions or re-upload attachments automatically.
requirements.acceptance: Generate two answers, switch versions, reload and confirm calendar/file counts unchanged.

requirements.title: Rate a response
requirements.requirement: Provide optional thumbs up/down, optional reason and minimal retained metadata. A rating can be changed or removed where supported. Never force feedback before continuing.
requirements.acceptance: Rating persists to the real feedback system and surfaces in aggregate management metrics.

requirements.title: Report a problem
requirements.requirement: Offer inaccurate information, unsafe answer, privacy issue, technical problem and other. Preview exactly what is attached, with conversation inclusion off by default.
requirements.acceptance: Submission reaches an authorised management queue, returns a receipt, and handles failure without a false success.

requirements.title: Share safely
requirements.requirement: Offer a reviewable snapshot of selected content, never an entire account. Private file contents and membership-only institutional material are excluded unless an explicitly authorised sharing design allows them.
requirements.acceptance: Before publication show audience, included content, expiry and revoke controls; guessed IDs cannot retrieve unshared material.

requirements.title: Manage shared links
requirements.requirement: Support expiry, revocation, deletion and a clear read-only shared view. Revoke account-owned shares on account deletion. Indexing policy and source attribution are explicit.
requirements.acceptance: A revoked link no longer returns the snapshot; opening it never grants membership or account access.

requirements.title: Smart titles
requirements.requirement: Use the actual conversation goal, not greetings or sensitive identifiers. Preserve manual names; update only eligible automatic names as a task becomes clear.
requirements.acceptance: Hi followed by a housing question becomes a useful title; a manually renamed chat never changes.

requirements.title: Chat organisation
requirements.requirement: New chat, search, pin, archive, rename and delete operate on the same history on desktop and mobile. Empty/no-match states are distinct.
requirements.acceptance: Search covers permitted saved turns without leaking another account’s content.

requirements.title: Reply actions design
requirements.requirement: Copy, Listen and More are quiet on desktop hover/focus and readily available on touch. Do not hide functionality solely behind hover.
requirements.acceptance: All actions can be reached by keyboard and a touch device.

requirements.title: Draft and scroll stability
requirements.requirement: Preserve draft text and attachments through navigation, update prompts and failed sends. Follow new replies only when the reader is following the bottom.
requirements.acceptance: Scrolling up stays put as content arrives; returning to latest is explicit.

requirements.title: Cancel a request
requirements.requirement: Stop cancels the relevant client request, prevents late UI writes and restores an unsent/failed question according to the existing contract. Track uncertain paid outcomes honestly.
requirements.acceptance: Account/chat switch and Stop cannot inject an old response into a different conversation.

requirements.title: Decide act check loop
requirements.requirement: Retain an agent loop that selects the next useful research action from the goal and evidence, checks the result and stops when the actual request is satisfied.
requirements.acceptance: It can change strategy after a dead page or incomplete directory, without hardcoded school names.

requirements.title: Source classes
requirements.requirement: Official rules require the appropriate government/regulator; organisation facts use its verified site or clearly labelled self-description; community experiences are labelled and separate.
requirements.acceptance: Forum advice cannot become a visa rule; a school’s site cannot become a regulator classification.

requirements.title: Broad discovery with strict claims
requirements.requirement: Search the wider web for leads when appropriate, then open and classify relevant sources. Do not restrict discovery to one connected directory.
requirements.acceptance: A named school absent from an indexed register can be researched through its own site with honest limitations.

requirements.title: Jurisdiction and context
requirements.requirement: Keep UAE emirates and UK nations/cities distinct. Dates, age/year groups, visa categories, campuses and provider branches are material qualifiers.
requirements.acceptance: Dubai is not answered from Sharjah rules; Grade 6 is not automatically Year 6.

requirements.title: Evidence per factual assertion
requirements.requirement: Contacts, amounts, dates, addresses and eligibility statements remain tied to the supporting source and subject. Unsupported facts are omitted or explicitly unconfirmed.
requirements.acceptance: Gold/Silver price mixing, menu curricula, related-school text and wrong-campus contacts are rejected.

requirements.title: Conflicting evidence
requirements.requirement: State what each source says, source date and remaining uncertainty. Do not force an agreement or turn an old report into current status.
requirements.acceptance: School website/regulator curriculum disagreement is retained and understandable.

requirements.title: Completeness claims
requirements.requirement: All means complete only when a complete scoped authoritative result is actually read and the tool confirms it. Distinguish emirate/city, curriculum and year filters.
requirements.acceptance: The same three schools are not repeated as every school; a bounded partial list states coverage.

requirements.title: Relevance and pagination
requirements.requirement: Avoid duplicate places, support more with a safe continuation cursor and preserve current filters. On a fresh request, stop inheriting obsolete constraints.
requirements.acceptance: Find more returns new matches; a new unrestricted request does not inherit Year 6.

requirements.title: Safe search terms
requirements.requirement: Send minimal checked general terms to search, not the conversation, children’s names, document text, ID numbers or secret tokens.
requirements.acceptance: A conversation containing a synthetic child’s name never places that name into search.

requirements.title: Safe page handling
requirements.requirement: Validate external targets, redirects, schemes and ownership. Bound page sizes, fetch counts, time and data retained. Treat page/document instructions as untrusted content.
requirements.acceptance: Prompt-injection pages cannot change system rules, reveal secrets or cause an unrelated send.

requirements.title: Useful failure
requirements.requirement: Explain what could not be checked and a sourced next step. Do not pretend no result means no organisation exists.
requirements.acceptance: Outages, limits and uncertain identities produce different truthful responses.

requirements.title: Advice and action
requirements.requirement: Explain options and the next practical step, proportionate to evidence and risk. Avoid unsupported personalised medical/legal determinations and invented emergency contacts.
requirements.acceptance: Housing urgency triggers useful scam-aware help and a draft when requested, not another institution question.

requirements.title: Measure actual latency
requirements.requirement: Measure send to first visible real status, first useful checked text, full reply, tools, provider calls and audio playback start. Separate cold/warm, failures and cancellations.
requirements.acceptance: Release report contains raw sample counts, median and p95 where sample size permits, versions and no fabricated benchmark.

requirements.title: Performance targets
requirements.requirement: Use targets rather than promises: interaction feedback under 100 ms, useful status under 1 s, ordinary non-research answers ideally within 5 s, initial useful research content ideally within 10 s. Full answers depend on provider/source work.
requirements.acceptance: Failure to meet a target is reported with measured cause, not hidden by a typing animation.

requirements.title: Remove repeated work
requirements.requirement: Reuse exact successful searches/pages within a permitted turn, batch independent calls, avoid duplicate startup/session/membership fetches and unnecessary model corrections.
requirements.acceptance: Equivalent scenario before/after records fewer real calls with unchanged source/permission checks.

requirements.title: True streaming contract
requirements.requirement: Implement explicit progress, checked text, metadata, completion, cancellation and error events with request/turn IDs. Parse partial network frames and reconnect/failure safely.
requirements.acceptance: Several network chunks arrive and render before completion in an integration test; no fake sleep is counted as streaming.

requirements.title: Verify before presentation
requirements.requirement: Never stream unverified prices, contacts or official requirements as settled facts. A reviewed sentence/segment verification design may release checked pieces while remaining work continues.
requirements.acceptance: A later validation failure cannot leave an already displayed unsupported claim appearing confirmed.

requirements.title: Progressive display fallback
requirements.requirement: When streaming is unavailable, reveal the checked result smoothly with a short bounded animation, immediate reduced-motion mode and exact citation restoration.
requirements.acceptance: Long replies do not gain many seconds of artificial presentation delay.

requirements.title: Thinking text is truthful
requirements.requirement: Show real activities, not private model reasoning or invented progress. Translate statuses and distinguish delayed sources from generating the final reply.
requirements.acceptance: An unavailable source never appears as successfully checked while the spinner continues.

requirements.title: Listen startup
requirements.requirement: On tap show Preparing audio immediately, provide Stop and timeout/fallback, and measure time to first audible sample. Prefer supported chunked playback when it preserves the checked text and language.
requirements.acceptance: Repeated tap does not create duplicate paid jobs; Cancel stops playback and late responses.

requirements.title: Private audio reuse
requirements.requirement: Reuse an identical reply’s already generated audio in bounded device memory/session where consent allows. No cross-user shared audio cache and no automatic playback.
requirements.acceptance: Second Listen can reuse local audio; logout/account switch revokes object URLs and clears it.

requirements.title: Audio budget and fidelity
requirements.requirement: Keep existing caps, explicit AI voice disclosure and device-voice fallback. Read only the selected answer, excluding reference URLs, controls and citation markers.
requirements.acceptance: Playback never invents paraphrased advice, uses a wrong language silently or bypasses the voice cap.

requirements.title: Universal planning architecture
requirements.requirement: Use an extensible plan schema rather than hand-writing every possible journey. Combine reviewed templates with evidence-grounded personalised drafts for uncovered goals.
requirements.acceptance: A novel legitimate task produces a clearly labelled draft or an honest limitation instead of a false reviewed guide.

requirements.title: Offer before opening
requirements.requirement: When the conversation indicates a multi-step goal, offer Would you like to see the X plan with a concise explanation and accept/decline. Do not inject or auto-save a large plan without consent.
requirements.acceptance: User can decline and keep talking; repeating the same declined offer is avoided.

requirements.title: Plan contents
requirements.requirement: Every plan has goal, scope, jurisdiction, applicability, steps, dependencies, evidence, estimated/unknown timings, owner, actions and completion criteria.
requirements.acceptance: A plan explains what comes next and what blocks it; unknown fees/timings are not invented.

requirements.title: Step states
requirements.requirement: Support not started, ready, in progress, waiting for you, waiting for organisation, blocked, done and not applicable, with Undo/history and source of state.
requirements.acceptance: Marking a personal task done never becomes authoritative approval of a visa or medical result.

requirements.title: Preparation and missing documents
requirements.requirement: Show prerequisites and checklist before the user reaches a deadline. Attestation/document requirements are researched for the exact situation.
requirements.acceptance: Family-schooling scenario identifies the need to check document recognition without asserting one rule for all families.

requirements.title: Chat to plan continuity
requirements.requirement: Ask about this step opens Chat with a visible permitted context label; actions return to the same plan and progress.
requirements.acceptance: Refresh, Back, correction and account switching preserve the right plan without leaking another space.

requirements.title: Maintain reviewed content
requirements.requirement: Reviewed templates have version, jurisdiction, source dates, reviewer and next-review date. Generated drafts are visibly distinct and can become reviewed only through staff workflow.
requirements.acceptance: A stale template is marked stale and updated without erasing the user’s completed history.

requirements.title: Plan changes
requirements.requirement: When dates or requirements change, show a diff and ask before altering saved reminders or steps. Record old/new versions.
requirements.acceptance: An institution updating a guide cannot silently erase or falsely complete a student’s work.

requirements.title: Shared-device and family use
requirements.requirement: Allow separately labelled dependants/plans without collecting sensitive identifiers by default. Personal accounts remain private; no assumed guardian access.
requirements.acceptance: Two children’s school tasks remain distinguishable without requiring passport numbers.

requirements.title: Coverage and discovery
requirements.requirement: Seed the coverage catalogue below and maintain a missing-topic queue. Coverage means the planner recognises a topic and can research safely, not that all answers are prewritten.
requirements.acceptance: Each catalogue family has at least one synthetic happy-path and one uncertainty/failure scenario.

requirements.title: Library composition
requirements.requirement: Provide All, Plans and guides, Saved places and services, Files, and optionally Saved conversations/links, with search and filters. Reuse existing data/IDs rather than copying collections.
requirements.acceptance: Existing saved guides, files and shortlists survive migration with unchanged ownership.

requirements.title: Auto-save valid discoveries
requirements.requirement: Founder decision: useful places/services/sites Orivia recommends are automatically retained privately in Saved from chat, linked to the originating answer. This does not grant permission to save arbitrary browsed pages or tracking pixels.
requirements.acceptance: A sourced service card creates one private discovery; repeated mention does not create duplicates.

requirements.title: Intentional favourites
requirements.requirement: Keep explicit favourite/pin/shortlist selection distinct from automatically saved discoveries, even if the UI groups them. Explain why an item is saved and allow removal.
requirements.acceptance: User can find both all suggested options and only the ones they deliberately favour.

requirements.title: Discovery provenance
requirements.requirement: Save stable entity ID, exact name, source URL/type, checked date, location/campus, originating chat/turn and current user. Contacts remain evidence-backed.
requirements.acceptance: A later source correction updates the entity with history instead of inventing new contact details.

requirements.title: Permission changes
requirements.requirement: A saved bookmark does not grant permanent access to university-only content. Recheck membership before opening or sending it to AI.
requirements.acceptance: Leaving a university hides protected bodies while allowing a non-sensitive unavailable bookmark.

requirements.title: Remove and restore semantics
requirements.requirement: Explain removal from Library versus deletion of original chat/file. Provide reversible removal for a discovery where feasible; file deletion remains separately confirmed.
requirements.acceptance: Removing one saved school does not delete the conversation or another user’s saved school.

requirements.title: Search sorting and filters
requirements.requirement: Search titles and authorised metadata, filter by type/country/space and sort recent/alphabetical/pinned. Show no-results recovery without losing state.
requirements.acceptance: A filtered view never makes unselected files or private source bodies available to another account.

requirements.title: Useful cards
requirements.requirement: Show one clear identity, relevant facts, source freshness and only supported Call/Email/Website/Map actions. Bulk selection can prepare a reviewed contact draft.
requirements.acceptance: Missing contacts produce no fake button; application messages are not sent automatically.

requirements.title: Export
requirements.requirement: Export the user’s selected data in usable formats without secretly including private files or other institutions’ content. Include dates/source references.
requirements.acceptance: Export preview and downloadable result match the authorised selection.

requirements.title: Storage limits
requirements.requirement: Show actual storage use and limits. When full, refuse new writes with a durable notice; no automatic eviction or silent transcript truncation.
requirements.acceptance: A full device/account preserves existing files, chat versions, plans and calendar events.

requirements.title: Swipe between weeks
requirements.requirement: Support horizontal swipe on the week strip only, with a movement threshold, vertical-scroll rejection, cancellation and one change per gesture. Keep arrow buttons and keyboard alternatives.
requirements.acceptance: Swipe left/right advances one week; scrolling the page vertically or tapping a day does not. Test RTL direction intentionally.

requirements.title: Understand calendar actions
requirements.requirement: Create, edit, reschedule and delete existing reminders through explicit review. Resolve ambiguous targets/times, preserve unspecified fields and support Undo.
requirements.acceptance: Change it to 12pm changes the intended reminder only; what or I am lost does not replay an old edit.

requirements.title: Time correctness
requirements.requirement: Use the user/device time zone, handle day boundaries, daylight saving and travel between UK/UAE. Show source timezone where supplied by an organisation.
requirements.acceptance: UK DST transition, Dubai-to-London travel and repeated local times produce reviewable correct dates.

requirements.title: External calendar handoffs
requirements.requirement: Offer Google, Outlook and Apple calendar handoffs appropriate to the device. Explain that external Save is required and no two-way sync exists unless implemented.
requirements.acceptance: Repeated Add from a university date detects the Orivia duplicate and does not silently duplicate it.

requirements.title: Directions card
requirements.requirement: Show resolved destination, mode and origin where known, with a single strong Open in maps action and an app picker when useful. Links are safely encoded.
requirements.acceptance: Driving stays driving; no public transport link is presented as the chosen car route.

requirements.title: Location permission
requirements.requirement: Offer Use my location explicitly, explain use and request device permission on tap. Allow a landmark/area fallback and clear current-location context.
requirements.acceptance: Denial, unavailable coordinates, stale location and offline state all allow a useful non-location path.

requirements.title: No guessed route data
requirements.requirement: Do not invent ETAs, routes, prices, live bus arrivals or map pins. Use a connected maps/transport source or explain the handoff.
requirements.acceptance: An ambiguous station name is resolved or labelled before directions; source URL is not guessed.

requirements.title: Show someone card
requirements.requirement: When offering a message to show another person, provide full-screen English, Arabic and user-language tabs, large text, Listen and clear Close.
requirements.acceptance: Translation preserves the message and supported names; switching languages never sends the message externally.

requirements.title: Permission control centre
requirements.requirement: Settings explains camera, microphone, location and notifications status where readable, with device settings guidance and graceful unknown states.
requirements.acceptance: A browser that cannot expose permission status shows Unknown rather than Enabled.

requirements.title: No permission wall
requirements.requirement: Microphone, photos and camera are requested only for their specific action. Notifications may be offered after setup but actual OS permission follows an explicit choice.
requirements.acceptance: Declining any permission does not block typed chat, manual place entry or ordinary app navigation.

requirements.title: Account and guest entry
requirements.requirement: Show sign in, sign up and continue as guest, with clear storage differences. Institution login is not impersonated by a generic email field.
requirements.acceptance: Guest use remains useful and guest data is never silently uploaded to a new account.

requirements.title: Remember multiple accounts
requirements.requirement: Provide Add account, active-account identity and Switch account using the existing auth library’s supported multi-session capability after version/security review. No custom localStorage bearer-token stash.
requirements.acceptance: Two verified synthetic accounts can be remembered and selected without typing credentials again while sessions remain valid.

requirements.title: Server-authorised switching
requirements.requirement: List only sessions legitimately present on this device; switch through a same-origin authenticated server route. Do not accept an arbitrary user ID/token as proof.
requirements.acceptance: Forged account IDs and unrelated sessions cannot be activated.

requirements.title: Clear old account surfaces first
requirements.requirement: Abort chat/audio/file work, revoke photo/object URLs, clear in-memory cards and search, switch account-scoped storage, then load the new identity and memberships.
requirements.acceptance: Late requests and cached thumbnails cannot appear after switching accounts.

requirements.title: Tabs have one active identity policy
requirements.requirement: Choose a single active account across tabs for this release and broadcast changes safely. Protect unsaved drafts with an account-specific recoverable state before switching.
requirements.acceptance: Switch in one tab updates others; account A draft never becomes account B’s message.

requirements.title: Session management
requirements.requirement: Show remembered accounts and active devices without exposing raw tokens. Support sign out this account, remove from this device and sign out all with precise scope.
requirements.acceptance: Expired/revoked sessions require authentication; removal of one account preserves the others.

requirements.title: Verify privileged actions
requirements.requirement: Owner/staff access always comes from server roles, not email domains or client controls. Recent authentication and confirmation protect sensitive role/config changes.
requirements.acceptance: A student with a university email cannot grant staff access or open owner controls.

requirements.title: Account recovery
requirements.requirement: Provide supported email verification/recovery within actual email caps and a clear rate-limit state. Avoid revealing whether an unrelated email has an account.
requirements.acceptance: One-use expired codes, resend, caps and provider failure have working recovery paths.

requirements.title: Deletion and exports
requirements.requirement: Users can request export and delete their own account with clear effects, membership obligations and reliable file cleanup. Never delete files while the account still exists.
requirements.acceptance: The interrupted deletion reproduction stays fixed; shares/push/session data are revoked as applicable.

requirements.title: Owner recovery and access resilience
requirements.requirement: Provide documented owner recovery/transfer and prevent accidental last-owner deletion or lockout. Back up operational recovery instructions privately.
requirements.acceptance: Deleting or demoting the last authorised owner is refused with a useful explanation.

requirements.title: Executive overview
requirements.requirement: Show actual users/accounts, active organisations, join funnel, request success/failure, latency, budget use, feedback queue and service health, each with date range and metric definition.
requirements.acceptance: Cards drill into the correct filtered view; unavailable data is labelled unavailable rather than a fabricated zero.

requirements.title: Organisation directory
requirements.requirement: Search/filter organisations by status, type, country, plan and health; open details with active admins, content, integrations and distribution status.
requirements.acceptance: Create/update/pause/reactivate an organisation with audit events and membership isolation.

requirements.title: Platform access
requirements.requirement: Owner can manage authorised platform staff roles, invite/revoke staff, inspect effective permissions and review privileged actions. Do not turn full control into automatic access to private chats/files.
requirements.acceptance: Every denied direct API request remains denied even if the UI is modified.

requirements.title: People and memberships
requirements.requirement: Search accounts for legitimate administration, show verification/state and organisation relationships, and provide narrowly scoped support actions.
requirements.acceptance: Owner support views minimise personal data and do not display private message text by default.

requirements.title: Real product analytics
requirements.requirement: Measure documented events such as new account, welcome completion, plan offer/accept, safe action, feedback and error. Do not log raw chat text or sensitive profile fields for analytics.
requirements.acceptance: Every displayed metric has a query definition, event source, retention and validation against synthetic events.

requirements.title: AI operations
requirements.requirement: Show provider availability, response/first-audio latency, error categories, source-fetch failures, model-call counts, rejection rates and budget blocks.
requirements.acceptance: Drilldown uses request IDs/status metadata, not hidden prompts or customer documents.

requirements.title: Budgets and limits
requirements.requirement: Display actual daily/monthly usage by service, reservations, uncertain charges and cap remaining. Offer restricted cap controls and kill switches with previews.
requirements.acceptance: A cap change is authenticated/audited; no new spend is enabled by a visual toggle alone.

requirements.title: Content and Journey governance
requirements.requirement: Manage template catalogue, coverage gaps, source registry, revisions, approvals, stale content and jurisdiction.
requirements.acceptance: A published template/source change has review history and can be rolled back.

requirements.title: Feedback and support inbox
requirements.requirement: Collect user-submitted reports, ratings and reviewed attachments into a searchable queue with severity, assignee, state, notes and resolution.
requirements.acceptance: Reports created in Chat appear once with only the content the person agreed to attach.

requirements.title: Partners and sponsors
requirements.requirement: Maintain partner pipeline, contacts supplied for business use, agreements/status, campaigns, placements, dates and approval records. Sponsorship is labelled and never changes official evidence standards.
requirements.acceptance: No partner record becomes a public endorsement or paid campaign without a deliberate publish action.

requirements.title: Commercial controls
requirements.requirement: Show plans, entitlements and invoice/payment status only from a configured billing source. Until configured, manage draft pricing/contract records without fake revenue.
requirements.acceptance: A failed payment does not silently remove the promised free basic help; premium boundaries are clear.

requirements.title: Communications
requirements.requirement: Draft segmented service announcements with audience count, preview, test mode, scheduling, cancellation and sending limits. Marketing choice is separate from essential service messages.
requirements.acceptance: A test uses synthetic recipients; no mass send occurs without the authorised final action.

requirements.title: Releases and incidents
requirements.requirement: Show deployed source/version, feature switches, migrations, test receipts, incidents, rollback points and status banner controls.
requirements.acceptance: Pilot/production are clearly distinguished and one-click UI cannot accidentally target the wrong environment.

requirements.title: Privacy operations
requirements.requirement: Support access/export/deletion requests, processing status, retention jobs, failed cleanup, share revocation and audit review.
requirements.acceptance: A failed cleanup remains visible for follow-up after bounded automatic retries.

requirements.title: Administrative power boundaries
requirements.requirement: Owner has full product and operational control appropriate to the platform. Private customer content requires a specific support/consent or separately justified controlled access process, not a permanent browse-everything page.
requirements.acceptance: No support impersonation/backdoor route bypasses account and organisation boundaries.

requirements.title: Institution overview
requirements.requirement: Present a polished workspace with service health, outstanding content reviews, invitations/join requests, upcoming dates, support load and integration freshness. Show institution branding without claiming a real partner when using Northbay demo.
requirements.acceptance: An admin sees clear next actions; an editor sees only permitted ones.

requirements.title: Guidance CMS
requirements.requirement: Create structured guides, FAQs, contacts, dates and updates with source URL, jurisdiction, campus, responsible team, review date, revision and draft/review/published/archived states.
requirements.acceptance: Editors draft; authorised staff approve/publish; stale updates and conflicting edits are handled.

requirements.title: Approval and preview
requirements.requirement: Preview exact student rendering in supported languages and compare revisions before publishing. Prevent accidental publish of draft/private content.
requirements.acceptance: A revision that loses required contact/source/date fields shows a validation error.

requirements.title: Process builder
requirements.requirement: Define a process as stages with explanations, dependencies, required student actions, responsible office, source and escalation route. Keep official approvals separate from user-marked tasks.
requirements.acceptance: A visa appointment completed state cannot become fingerprints approved.

requirements.title: Campus directory
requirements.requirement: Manage real campus places/services, locations, opening hours, contact methods, accessible routes and source/last reviewed fields.
requirements.acceptance: The student gets the correct campus printer/service team, not generic web instructions.

requirements.title: Dates and announcements
requirements.requirement: Publish targeted key dates and announcements with time zone, audience, expiry, related guide and notification preview.
requirements.acceptance: Expired notices stop appearing; editing a date explains what happens to previously saved reminders.

requirements.title: Invitations and QR studio
requirements.requirement: Generate public landing QR, time-limited invitation QR and campaign attribution codes with clear differences. Add logo/download options, preview URL, expiry/revoke and usage counts.
requirements.acceptance: QR decodes to the intended canonical domain and never grants personal-record access.

requirements.title: Members and join requests
requirements.requirement: Provide search, filters, paging, pending requests, membership approval/removal and rejoin controls. Role changes are explicit and auditable.
requirements.acceptance: An editor cannot see member email lists or approve a request merely by calling the API.

requirements.title: Staff access
requirements.requirement: Invite admins/editors under least privilege, show effective capabilities and revoke sessions/access correctly. Prevent removing the last responsible administrator without transfer.
requirements.acceptance: Revoked staff cannot publish or read new protected content, including through an old tab.

requirements.title: Support and escalation
requirements.requirement: Provide a real support queue or a clearly identified handoff to the institution’s chosen contact system. Students review submitted summaries and attachments.
requirements.acceptance: No private chat is shared with staff unless the student selects it for a support request.

requirements.title: Privacy-safe service analytics
requirements.requirement: Provide joins, invitation usage, content service health and genuinely safe aggregate performance metrics. Keep student Done marks private until a reviewed non-inferential reporting design is approved.
requirements.acceptance: Exact completion totals remain disabled around removals/opt-outs; no five-to-six-person differencing leak.

requirements.title: Data separation
requirements.requirement: University staff do not access personal chats, files, profile, calendar, other universities or unrelated plan activity through their dashboard.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-tenant and direct-object access tests cover every staff endpoint and export.

requirements.title: Brand and onboarding controls
requirements.requirement: Set permitted institution name/logo/colour accents, campus, destination/reason defaults, welcome guidance and contact channels. Preserve core Orivia navigation and accessibility.
requirements.acceptance: Preview and actual join flow agree; organisation branding cannot spoof an unaffiliated university.

requirements.title: Connection centre
requirements.requirement: List supported integrations, permissions, setup prerequisites, credential status, last sync, errors and disconnect. Use a read-only sandbox adapter before any real partner connection.
requirements.acceptance: Unconfigured integrations show honest setup states and no invented student application statuses.

requirements.title: Institution administration
requirements.requirement: Manage notification categories, retention/contact policy, service owners and export permissions. Supply audit history and accessible settings.
requirements.acceptance: Changes do not retroactively grant consent, broaden student data access or bypass platform caps.

requirements.title: Branded student Home
requirements.requirement: Show relevant university guidance, next steps, dates, campus contacts and support in the same app, with an obvious switch to personal Orivia.
requirements.acceptance: Refresh, Back and deep links return to the right university context.

requirements.title: Joining is not authentication bypass
requirements.requirement: Public QR opens the university page; membership or institutional login is separately verified before protected information.
requirements.acceptance: A copied public QR cannot open another student’s records.

requirements.title: Application timeline
requirements.requirement: For configured authorised connections show source system, exact status wording, timestamp, next action and responsible team. If no connection, do not show a simulated personal timeline.
requirements.acceptance: An old record is labelled stale and a missing predicted completion date is not invented.

requirements.title: University-aware Chat
requirements.requirement: Only selected/authorised context enters Chat, with visible institution/source label and server-side membership checks each time.
requirements.acceptance: Revocation after opening a guide prevents its text being used in a later provider request.

requirements.title: Student tasks
requirements.requirement: Personal Done marks and reminders remain useful independently of analytics. Clearly distinguish personal completion from university-confirmed status.
requirements.acceptance: Private marks continue to work while staff totals are paused.

requirements.title: Useful campus assistance
requirements.requirement: Handle printing, borrowing equipment, accessibility, wellbeing, accommodation help and correct office routing using approved campus content.
requirements.acceptance: A laptop-versus-phone printing question asks only relevant details and links the actual campus instructions.

requirements.title: Support requests
requirements.requirement: Prepare a reviewable request, let the student choose contact and attachments, show sending status and a reference when an actual ticket exists.
requirements.acceptance: Without a connected sender, open an editable email draft and never claim it was submitted.

requirements.title: Leaving and rejoining
requirements.requirement: Explain what membership removal changes, keep personal data separate and withdraw access to protected guides/records and future institutional alerts.
requirements.acceptance: Downloaded information is not silently refreshed after leaving and the app does not promise to erase copies on someone else’s device.

requirements.title: Adapter contract
requirements.requirement: Define read-only adapters for identity, status timeline, timetable and support ticket lookup with explicit permissions and a server-held credential.
requirements.acceptance: A fixture adapter and contract tests work; no real connection is called configured without credentials and partner agreement.

requirements.title: Identity mapping
requirements.requirement: Match the authenticated person to an institution-issued record using approved identity claims, not a user-entered student ID alone.
requirements.acceptance: Changing a student ID parameter cannot retrieve another person’s status.

requirements.title: Inbound updates
requirements.requirement: Verify webhook signatures, timestamps, replay protection, schema, idempotency and institution routing. Polling uses bounded backoff when webhooks are unavailable.
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate/replayed/out-of-order events do not duplicate notifications or regress a newer status.

requirements.title: Provenance and freshness
requirements.requirement: Retain source event/version, received time, recorded time and last successful sync. Preserve the original status meaning.
requirements.acceptance: University submitted is never labelled government approved.

requirements.title: Disconnect and revoke
requirements.requirement: Disconnect stops future reads/updates, revokes provider credentials and explains retained records/retention.
requirements.acceptance: Queued updates cannot continue writing after revocation.

requirements.title: Integration readiness boundary
requirements.requirement: Build interfaces and sandbox tests now; real university SSO, visa databases and government status connections remain external until access is authorised.
requirements.acceptance: Release notes separate connector software readiness from a verified live university integration.

requirements.title: Metric definitions
requirements.requirement: Document name, purpose, numerator/denominator, time zone, event source, aggregation interval, retention and permitted roles for every metric.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic event totals reconcile with the dashboard and export.

requirements.title: No raw content telemetry
requirements.requirement: Exclude raw prompts, transcripts, documents, personal identifiers, access tokens and precise location from general product analytics.
requirements.acceptance: Request/event inspection confirms only approved metadata is retained.

requirements.title: Aggregate disclosure risk
requirements.requirement: Suppress small cohorts and also prevent differencing, repeated-query and membership-change inference. Counts alone are not a guarantee of anonymity.
requirements.acceptance: Admin removal/opt-out/single-completion tests cannot reveal an individual mark.

requirements.title: Purpose and choice
requirements.requirement: Keep analytics choices separate from core help, AI processing, notifications and marketing. Private plans keep working when sharing is declined.
requirements.acceptance: Turning off optional reporting does not block student guidance or reminders.

requirements.title: No fabricated engagement
requirements.requirement: Do not infer guide views from published count, active users from sessions created, or delivery from provider acceptance. Label metric limitations.
requirements.acceptance: An unavailable view-tracking system displays unavailable, not 0 percent engagement.

requirements.title: Safe exports
requirements.requirement: Export only metrics and fields allowed for the actor and organisation, with bounded ranges and audit. Protect CSV formula injection.
requirements.acceptance: A malicious display name cannot execute a spreadsheet formula on export.

requirements.title: Retention and deletion
requirements.requirement: Expire analytics according to a documented schedule and remove identifiable links when required by the actual retention policy.
requirements.acceptance: Deletion tests cover account-linked feedback/events without corrupting legitimate aggregate history.

requirements.title: Operational observability
requirements.requirement: Keep request correlation IDs, stage durations and error codes useful for diagnosis while scrubbing provider error bodies.
requirements.acceptance: A provider error that echoes a prompt is not copied into public/client logs.

requirements.title: Supported private files
requirements.requirement: Keep supported PDF/JPEG/PNG handling with existing size/account/day limits; verify content rather than trusting filename. Use authorised private account routes or guest browser storage.
requirements.acceptance: Another account cannot list/open/rename/delete a file by guessing its ID.

requirements.title: Camera flow
requirements.requirement: Capture, preview, retake, rotate/crop where supported, choose name and save/use in Chat. Camera permission follows the action.
requirements.acceptance: Camera denial or unsupported image format offers upload/manual fallback without losing typed text.

requirements.title: Consent before transmission
requirements.requirement: Confirm the selected file goes to OpenAI for input counting and, when budget permits, extraction. Distinguish that from saving in Library and later transcript reuse.
requirements.acceptance: No old sent-once promise remains; consent version is checked server-side.

requirements.title: Processing bounds
requirements.requirement: Retain streaming upload and decompression limits, reliable page counting, PDF safety refusal and token-count reservation.
requirements.acceptance: Dense, damaged, encrypted, oversized and expansion-bomb synthetic files fail safely before an unreserved generation.

requirements.title: Document context
requirements.requirement: Retain transcripts with their chat, include newest-three/combined text limit honestly and show partial extraction/context. Do not send all Library files.
requirements.acceptance: Fourth-document and long-document scenarios visibly explain excluded/truncated context.

requirements.title: No authenticity claims
requirements.requirement: Say what the document appears to state. Reading is not verification, official approval, eligibility or a legal interpretation.
requirements.acceptance: A tenancy agreement is not treated as proof a landlord is genuine.

requirements.title: Separate deletion effects
requirements.requirement: Deleting a Library original and deleting a chat transcript are separate actions with clear consequences. Account deletion includes durable cleanup and inaccessible retained tasks.
requirements.acceptance: Interrupted cleanup preserves active-user files and later retries only a genuinely deleted account.

requirements.title: Provider retention honesty
requirements.requirement: Describe actual provider storage/data controls and service routing; store false is not a zero-retention promise. No special retention approval is assumed.
requirements.acceptance: Privacy text and request settings agree for counting, extraction and follow-up Chat.

requirements.title: Ten-language coverage matrix
requirements.requirement: Track English, French, Arabic, Filipino, Hindi, Urdu, Chinese, Bengali, Malayalam and Russian separately for UI, model replies, dictation and Listen.
requirements.acceptance: Matrix identifies actual tested support rather than one misleading all-languages tick.

requirements.title: Complete translations
requirements.requirement: Translate auth, onboarding, personal/student/staff/owner navigation, actions, errors, consent, status and empty states. Preserve original source quotes and user values.
requirements.acceptance: Locale sweeps find no unintended English labels; explicit unavailable translation fallback is visible.

requirements.title: Reply language follows intent
requirements.requirement: Respond in the user’s chosen/requested language and handle language changes mid-chat without inheriting unrelated tasks.
requirements.acceptance: French I am lost scenario stays in French and does not reopen an old calendar edit.

requirements.title: RTL and locale formatting
requirements.requirement: Use logical spacing/alignment, correct reading order, dates/numbers/currency and isolated links/identifiers for Arabic/Urdu.
requirements.acceptance: RTL drawer, week swipe, inline citations, inputs and institutional tables remain usable.

requirements.title: Dictation control
requirements.requirement: Keep microphone selection in Settings and the approved hover/hold affordance rather than a bulky permanent composer label. Stop to edit before sending.
requirements.acceptance: Speech never sends automatically; rejection/error preserves typed text.

requirements.title: Listen clarity
requirements.requirement: Use the correct language/voice, immediate preparing indicator, Stop, speed controls where supported and natural-voice preference/fallback.
requirements.acceptance: Missing Bengali/Malayalam/device voice is explained; no silently wrong-language playback.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.requirement: Support keyboard navigation, focus management, screen readers, contrast, large text, reduced motion and meaningful labels for icon controls.
requirements.acceptance: Automated checks plus manual keyboard/reader spot-checks pass core flows.

requirements.title: Plain language and reassurance
requirements.requirement: Explain acronyms and practical next steps without patronising, forced slang or endless Would you like me to help loops.
requirements.acceptance: An anxious newcomer receives concise actionable help and choices rather than a long generic disclaimer.

requirements.title: Separate inbox and push
requirements.requirement: Maintain unread inbox and bell red dot independently of phone delivery. Opening/marking read updates all relevant surfaces.
requirements.acceptance: A failed push still leaves the permitted inbox item, without claiming the device displayed it.

requirements.title: Explicit opt-in
requirements.requirement: Offer notifications after setup as approved; device permission requires a clear user choice, with separate reminder/membership/institution categories.
requirements.acceptance: Decline never blocks the app; categories can be changed later.

requirements.title: Generic lock screen
requirements.requirement: Push text is generic; documents, visa/health details, exact private titles and personal conversation never appear on the lock screen.
requirements.acceptance: A synthetic medical/visa event produces only a generic update alert.

requirements.title: Delivery reliability
requirements.requirement: Use the correct environment DB, bounded retries, idempotency and accurate attempted/accepted/failed/expired/uncertain counters.
requirements.acceptance: Pilot cannot target production registrations and a duplicate scheduler run does not double-send.

requirements.title: Access on open
requirements.requirement: Notification navigation rechecks sign-in, account and membership before showing detail.
requirements.acceptance: An old notification after logout or leaving an organisation does not reveal protected content.

requirements.title: Production enablement gate
requirements.requirement: Keep production push off until technical delivery, preferences, privacy copy and a real-device check pass. Cleo enables only after the final approval gate.
requirements.acceptance: The release receipt names the verified device/environment and actual disclosure version.

requirements.title: Free useful core
requirements.requirement: Keep the advertised basic relocation help, reliable sources, essential plans and useful guest access free. Premium is optional added value, not a surprise fee to complete a promised basic journey.
requirements.acceptance: Core onboarding and example newcomer needs complete without a subscription.

requirements.title: Institution purchase value
requirements.requirement: Sell connected institutional guidance, administration, distribution, service operations and authorised integrations. Students retain personal privacy.
requirements.acceptance: Institution entitlement grants service functions, not access to private chats.

requirements.title: Sponsorship boundaries
requirements.requirement: Label sponsored access and advertising clearly, record campaign approval and separate placement from factual recommendations.
requirements.acceptance: A sponsor cannot buy official-source status or silently reorder an evidence-based answer.

requirements.title: Billing readiness
requirements.requirement: Define plans, entitlements, cancellation, renewal and support before enabling payments. Use sandbox transactions until a provider/account is approved.
requirements.acceptance: The app cannot charge, renew or send invoices merely because a founder pricing field was edited.

requirements.title: Cost ceiling
requirements.requirement: Track total actual operating costs against the founder’s 250 AED monthly target, separating one-off/annual store expenses and existing caps. Do not add provider assumptions together as a guaranteed bill.
requirements.acceptance: A cost report lists service, cap, actual usage source, uncertainty and any externally required spending.

requirements.title: No automatic upgrades
requirements.requirement: Leave existing money/search/email/voice caps unchanged unless specifically authorised. Never purchase a plan or paid library to make a test pass.
requirements.acceptance: Blocked capacity is reported with an alternative or honest limitation, not silently paid for.

requirements.title: Complete policies
requirements.requirement: Prepare full Privacy and Terms aligned to actual accounts, AI providers, research, files, voice, notifications, analytics, sharing, support and organisation roles.
requirements.acceptance: Every policy statement maps to implementation; no obsolete private-trial/provider wording flashes.

requirements.title: Operator details
requirements.requirement: Do not publish the founder’s personal name/email from earlier messages. Suitable public operator/contact details remain a genuine publishing dependency if not supplied.
requirements.acceptance: No invented legal entity, fake address or hidden personal email appears on public pages.

requirements.title: Consent versions
requirements.requirement: Version materially changed notices independently where appropriate, retain records and keep optional choices unticked or off until selected.
requirements.acceptance: Refresh/account switch uses the correct recorded consent and a material change re-prompts only the necessary acknowledgement.

requirements.title: Data rights and support
requirements.requirement: Offer an actual contact/request route for data access, correction, export and deletion, with status and authenticated handling.
requirements.acceptance: An unrelated person cannot request another user’s data through a guessed address/ID.

requirements.title: Risk communication
requirements.requirement: Clearly separate official facts, institutional guidance, personal records, community reports and AI uncertainty. Avoid blanket verified or anonymous claims.
requirements.acceptance: The UI never turns successful page opening or aggregate counts into guarantees.

requirements.title: Claims and affiliation
requirements.requirement: No Oxford/Cambridge/Harvard/Heriot-Watt partnership logo/claim without approval. Northbay stays fictional/demo where used.
requirements.acceptance: App/website/store materials match actual partners and configured services.

requirements.title: Authentication and authorisation
requirements.requirement: Enforce same-origin protections, secure session handling, server-side roles, tenant checks, revocation and account-specific storage on every route.
requirements.acceptance: Direct endpoint attacks fail even when hidden controls or IDs are manipulated.

requirements.title: Secrets
requirements.requirement: Keep API/signing/email credentials in server secret storage; never log, embed, commit, display or ask the founder to paste them into chat.
requirements.acceptance: Secret scan and bundle/config review pass.

requirements.title: Abuse and quotas
requirements.requirement: Retain human verification and independent per-person/global/provider limits. Provide useful retry state without weakening guards for performance.
requirements.acceptance: Bot/abuse tests and legitimate expired-check recovery both pass.

requirements.title: Input and output safety
requirements.requirement: Escape user-supplied HTML, names, filenames, links and CSV values; prohibit executable URLs and private-network fetches.
requirements.acceptance: Hostile fixture set does not execute scripts, open internal services or expose unsafe contacts.

requirements.title: Idempotency
requirements.requirement: All saved effects, webhooks, submissions and retries have stable request identity where needed. A reconnect does not duplicate an event, ticket or charge.
requirements.acceptance: Repeat each effect twice and verify one intended durable change.

requirements.title: Backups and restore
requirements.requirement: Document database/object-storage backups and prove a synthetic restore/migration path. Never automatically evict saved chats to make space.
requirements.acceptance: Rollback preserves newer compatible user data or has an explicit restoration procedure.

requirements.title: Offline integrity
requirements.requirement: Cache only suitable app shell assets; private API/session/provider responses stay network-only. Unsynced drafts and saved permitted offline data are account-isolated.
requirements.acceptance: Offline refresh does not reveal the previous account or pretend to send a message.

requirements.title: Updates
requirements.requirement: Offer a manual reload/update notice while protecting drafts. Version service worker/assets correctly and avoid two competing workers for the same scope.
requirements.acceptance: An installed app upgrades without dropping a draft, attachment or saved plan.

requirements.title: Dependencies
requirements.requirement: Review pinned build dependencies, known high-severity audit findings and compatibility. Do not run a destructive automatic upgrade just to hide an audit count.
requirements.acceptance: Unresolved material vulnerabilities are documented or block release according to impact.

requirements.title: Incident controls
requirements.requirement: Provide provider/push/integration kill switches, clear degraded-mode copy and a tested rollback record.
requirements.acceptance: Disabling an optional provider leaves safe typed help or an honest temporary-unavailable state.

requirements.title: PWA first
requirements.requirement: Finish manifest, icons, theme, scope, install help, offline shell, updates, canonical links and guest/account restore on myorivia.app.
requirements.acceptance: Installed app opens into the app, and university invites remain in the correct flow.

requirements.title: Native package scope
requirements.requirement: Choose and document a wrapper/native approach that preserves web behaviour while supporting required camera, photos, microphone, location, notifications and deep links. Do not claim a wrapper alone guarantees store acceptance.
requirements.acceptance: A reproducible package build and native integration plan exist with no fake signed build.

requirements.title: Build provenance
requirements.requirement: Record bundle identifier, versions, supported devices, signing prerequisites, build tools and CI/artifact hashes. Credentials stay private.
requirements.acceptance: Another authorised developer can reproduce the same unsigned build from the recorded source.

requirements.title: Store materials
requirements.requirement: Prepare truthful app description, screenshots, privacy labels, age/content assessment, support/privacy URLs, review instructions and test access.
requirements.acceptance: Materials contain no mock partnership, unsupported language promise or private-trial gate blocking reviewers.

requirements.title: Store account and signing dependencies
requirements.requirement: Apple membership currently costs 99 USD per year, but enrolment, identity/legal entity, signing, build access, required metadata and review also matter. Do not describe payment as the only remaining condition without verification.
requirements.acceptance: Each external dependency is marked satisfied or blocked with actual evidence, not assumed.

requirements.title: Deletion and authentication review
requirements.requirement: Keep in-app account deletion and verify any authentication/store-specific requirements against current official guidance before submission.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewer can find and complete the supported account deletion initiation path.

requirements.title: Native device verification
requirements.requirement: Test installation, account switching, camera retake, dictation, location refusal, audio startup, push, safe areas, keyboard, offline and deep links on supported real devices.
requirements.acceptance: Unperformed physical-device tests are recorded as unverified; the founder is not assigned every intermediate test.

requirements.title: Submission boundary
requirements.requirement: Prepare all controllable assets and technical work; actual enrolment/payment/signing/submit steps remain with the authorised account holder and final approval.
requirements.acceptance: No purchase, binding acceptance or store submission occurs just because this master prompt exists.

requirements.title: Self-test before pilot
requirements.requirement: Cleo runs current relevant unit/integration suites, syntax/build checks, static security checks and local UI scenarios before deploying the combined candidate.
requirements.acceptance: No known failing required test is hidden behind a claim that unrelated suites pass.

requirements.title: Stable pilot candidate
requirements.requirement: Deploy to isolated pilot with intended switches, migrations and explicit snapshot. Freeze the candidate while Ina reviews; later changes create a new version.
requirements.acceptance: Ina knows exact source SHA, Worker version, schema migration and enabled features.

requirements.title: Independent deployed review
requirements.requirement: Ina checks the actual deployed pilot plus relevant source/evidence. Local fixtures are not substituted for real provider/installed-device verification.
requirements.acceptance: Review receipt labels source, scripted, live browser, real service and real-device evidence separately.

requirements.title: One founder acceptance
requirements.requirement: After technical review and fixes, present one final guided review with clear test accounts, short scenario list and any honest external blockers.
requirements.acceptance: No routine step in this specification requires founder approval/testing between individual components.

requirements.title: Fix and retest
requirements.requirement: Reproduce failures, fix at the correct layer, add meaningful regressions and rerun affected checks. Recheck combined flows after shared-file changes.
requirements.acceptance: A fix that restores one screen cannot erase another approved feature.

requirements.title: Production decision
requirements.requirement: Only the founder approves production promotion after seeing the stable candidate. Cleo records settings parity, secrets left intact and rollback before deploying.
requirements.acceptance: No pilot-ready declaration is treated as production approval.

requirements.title: Versioned receipt
requirements.requirement: Produce one machine-readable and human-readable report: candidate identifiers, completed requirements, exact commands/results, unresolved blockers, source coverage and rollback.
requirements.acceptance: Missing evidence keeps an item unverified rather than complete.

requirements.title: No fabricated certainty
requirements.requirement: A green test badge proves only its stated test. No all-done claim if SSO credentials, device tests, privacy contacts, signed builds or store review remain unavailable.
requirements.acceptance: The final readiness list says what is actually left, even when that is more than the store fee.

scenarios.title: Fresh guest on phone
scenarios.flow: Choose guest, complete welcome, decline optional permissions, ask a useful question, refresh and return.
scenarios.acceptance: No duplicate welcome, loss of consent/draft or forced account.

scenarios.title: School discovery
scenarios.flow: Find British curriculum schools in Sharjah for Year 6; ask only these, more, all and a named school.
scenarios.acceptance: Relevant scope retained, new results, honest completeness and supported contacts.

scenarios.title: Housing pressure
scenarios.flow: New Manchester student has a Facebook room, pre-viewing deposit and urgent pressure; asks for a message.
scenarios.acceptance: Practical scam-aware help and draft to landlord without an institution detour.

scenarios.title: Nol comparison
scenarios.flow: Compare Gold and Silver card price/included value using current official material.
scenarios.acceptance: Every number attached to the correct subject; no price mixing.

scenarios.title: Calendar correction
scenarios.flow: Create a reminder, change time to noon, say what, then switch to I am lost.
scenarios.acceptance: Review correct proposal; no stale reminder loop; unrelated help understood.

scenarios.title: Calendar swipe
scenarios.flow: Swipe week strip horizontally, scroll vertically, tap dates, use arrows and RTL.
scenarios.acceptance: Exactly intended week/day changes; accessible alternatives work.

scenarios.title: Lost in French
scenarios.flow: French-speaking newcomer has a landmark and destination on a laptop, asks to return.
scenarios.acceptance: French help, no guessed route, usable maps handoff/show-someone card.

scenarios.title: Account switching
scenarios.flow: Remember A and B, draft/attach in A, switch to B during processing, use two tabs.
scenarios.acceptance: No A messages, images, voice, files, memberships or late response leaks into B.

scenarios.title: Institution admission
scenarios.flow: Admin invites student, approves, student uses a guide/date, then membership is removed.
scenarios.acceptance: Roles, context, calendar duplicate checks and access-loss handling are correct.

scenarios.title: Analytics inference
scenarios.flow: Compare exact reports around removals, opt-out and one completion in a small known group.
scenarios.acceptance: No forbidden individual completion inference; private marks remain useful.

scenarios.title: Documents
scenarios.flow: Synthetic photo/PDF, long/third/fourth document, compressed/encrypted/oversized input, Cancel/switch.
scenarios.acceptance: Bounds, consent, cost reservation, partial notice and scope remain correct.

scenarios.title: Library discoveries
scenarios.flow: Recommend services twice, automatically save useful entities, favourite one, remove one, reload.
scenarios.acceptance: Private deduplicated provenance; favourites distinct; original chat remains.

scenarios.title: Journey continuity
scenarios.flow: Offer a plan, decline; offer a different relevant plan, accept, finish a step and return from Chat.
scenarios.acceptance: Offer consent, useful dependency order and durable progress.

scenarios.title: Message versions
scenarios.flow: Edit a user question, regenerate twice, switch versions and reload.
scenarios.acceptance: Correct selected context/sources and no duplicate reminders or document reads.

scenarios.title: Feedback and share
scenarios.flow: Rate/report a reply; preview a selected share, exclude a private attachment, revoke link.
scenarios.acceptance: Real queues, clear receipts, minimal data and effective revocation.

scenarios.title: Voice
scenarios.flow: Dictate and edit before send; Listen in different languages, Cancel, replay and switch accounts.
scenarios.acceptance: No automatic send/play, correct voice/fallback and measured startup.

scenarios.title: Owner console
scenarios.flow: Owner navigates organisations, costs, feedback, content, limits and audit; student tries same APIs.
scenarios.acceptance: Actual data/actions for owner and firm denial for unauthorised actor.

scenarios.title: University publishing
scenarios.flow: Editor drafts, admin reviews/publishes, date expires and revision changes while student is reading.
scenarios.acceptance: Approval, revision conflict, freshness and membership checks work.

scenarios.title: Notification reliability
scenarios.flow: Opt in/out categories; send a synthetic pilot alert; sign out/leave/delete; replay a job.
scenarios.acceptance: Generic payload, no duplicates, correct DB/identity and honest delivery state.

scenarios.title: Installed app
scenarios.flow: Install, cold start, update with draft, offline read, reconnect, deep link and permissions.
scenarios.acceptance: Stable PWA behaviour, no cached private API data and truthful offline status.

scenarios.title: Failure and budget
scenarios.flow: Exhaust search/provider/email allowance, break a source/provider, timeout a call, fill storage.
scenarios.acceptance: No guessing, secret leakage, unreserved spend, eviction or false success.

scenarios.title: UAE and UK parity
scenarios.flow: Run equivalent housing, school, transport, university and official-process questions in both countries.
scenarios.acceptance: Correct jurisdiction and source class; no UAE-only assumptions.

scenarios.title: All intended languages
scenarios.flow: Run UI/auth/errors/status/action/voice matrix for all ten intended languages including RTL.
scenarios.acceptance: Supported versus unavailable components stated explicitly; quotes/user data untouched.

scenarios.title: Deletion and recovery
scenarios.flow: Delete chat/file/account in separate scenarios, fail cleanup/storage, restore synthetic backup.
scenarios.acceptance: Correct scope, durable deletion jobs, active-account preservation and verified recovery.
